items.title: 两名拟任大使被否决，拉斯特里亚党内部歧见浮现
items.titleEn: Two proposed ambassadors rejected, exposing Rastriya Swatantra Party disagreements
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据加德满都邮报报道，议会听证委员会否决了拟任驻沙特阿拉伯大使吉里巴哈杜尔·苏纳尔和拟任驻马来西亚大使楚达马尼·卡雷尔的提名，理由涉及女性暴力、经济往来和利益冲突等问题；拟任驻日本大使贾南库马尔·塔帕的审议因需进一步调查而暂缓。报道称，该决定使拉斯特里亚党主席拉比·拉米查内与总理瓦伦德拉·沙阿两派之间的分歧公开化，并对政府宣称以公开竞争选拔大使的承诺提出疑问。
items.summaryEn: According to Kantipur, the parliamentary hearing committee rejected the nominations of proposed ambassadors to Saudi Arabia, Giribahadur Sunar, and to Malaysia, Chudamani Kharel, after questions arose over violence against women, financial dealings and conflict of interest; a decision on proposed ambassador to Japan Gyan Kumar Thapa was postponed pending further inquiry. The report says the move brought disagreements between RSP chairman Rabi Lamichhane and Prime Minister Balendra Shah into the open and raised questions about the government's stated commitment to selecting ambassadors through open competition.
items.analysis: 若报道所述程序问题属实，直接影响在于尼泊尔驻外使团人事安排延宕，领事与侨民服务以及双边事务衔接可能短期放缓，但报道未给出时间表。下一步应核实听证委员会正式决议文本与外交部提名记录，确认被否与暂缓的具体依据；现有证据仅为媒体转述的委员会说法与党内人士说法，缺少独立文件佐证。
items.analysisEn: If the procedural problems described are accurate, the direct impact is delayed staffing of Nepal's overseas missions, potentially slowing consular and diaspora services and bilateral engagement in the short term, though the report gives no timeline. Next, verify the hearing committee's formal decision text and the foreign ministry's nomination records to confirm the stated grounds for rejection and postponement; current evidence rests on media-relayed committee statements and party insiders, without independent documentation.

items.title: 马斯克称印度当地亿万富翁阻挠星链进入，尼泊尔存在政策障碍
items.titleEn: Musk says local billionaire blocked Starlink in India; policy hurdles in Nepal
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据加德满都邮报援引国际媒体，马斯克在社交平台X上指责印度亿万富翁穆克什·安巴尼阻挠星链进入印度市场，并称此举是维护垄断；报道称相关言论出现之际，信实Jio的估值被报下降至约1080亿美元。报道还称，星链在印度虽已获GM PCS许可，但最终安全审批和频谱分配仍未完成；在尼泊尔，报道指出现行电信政策要求互联网服务外资上限为80%、本地合作方至少持股20%，而星链希望全额外资进入，因此其进入尼泊尔仍不确定。
items.summaryEn: Citing international media, Kantipur reports that Elon Musk accused Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani on X of blocking Starlink's entry into India to protect a monopoly, as Reliance Jio's valuation was reported to have fallen to about $108 billion. The report says Starlink has obtained GM PCS permission in India but final security approval and spectrum allocation remain pending; in Nepal, it says the existing telecom policy caps foreign investment in internet services at 80 percent with at least 20 percent local partnership, while Starlink seeks full foreign ownership, leaving its Nepal entry uncertain.
items.analysis: 若报道所述政策条款属实，直接影响是尼泊尔卫星互联网准入规则可能决定偏远地区宽带供给格局，并影响现有持牌卫星服务商的竞争环境。分析仅为条件性判断：报道未提供监管机构决定、审批时间表或星链在尼泊尔的正式申请细节。下一步应核实尼泊尔电信管理局现行外资上限规定及是否启动修订程序，并区分企业表态与监管事实。
items.analysisEn: If the policy provisions described are accurate, the direct impact is that Nepal's satellite internet access rules could shape broadband supply in remote areas and affect competition among existing licensed satellite service providers. This is conditional analysis only: the report provides no regulator decision, approval timetable or formal Starlink application details for Nepal. Next, verify the Nepal Telecommunications Authority's current foreign ownership cap and whether any revision process has begun, and separate corporate statements from regulatory facts.
